SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT id_student FROM studentAssessment JOIN assessments ON studentAssessment.id_assessment = assessments.id_assessment WHERE assessments.code_module = 'BBB' AND assessments.code_presentation = '2013J' AND assessments.assessment_type = 'TMA' GROUP BY id_student HAVING count(DISTINCT assessments.id_assessment) = (SELECT count(*) FROM assessments WHERE code_module = 'BBB' AND code_presentation = '2013J' AND assessment_type = 'TMA'))
